name: Spawnbed Protector
oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, return up to one target Eldrazi creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Create two 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."
blocked_sentences: Create two 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}."

needs.what: a 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion creature token with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." (e.g. id eldrazi_scion_1_1_c)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has eldrazi_spawn_0_1_c (a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn with the same mana ability) but no Eldrazi Scion; a 0/1 Spawn is not a 1/1 Scion. The rest of the card (end_step trigger with an up-to-one graveyard target of an Eldrazi creature card, return_to_hand) is expressible once the token exists
